testcase.name: Scenario: Preserve a staged ribbon edit while viewing keyboard customization: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:452:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Preserve a staged ribbon edit while viewing keyboard customization ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog has an empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel ✔ And the user selects the "Keyboard" customization tab ✔ Then the keyboard command list is displayed ✔ And "Apply" and "Cancel" remain available ✔ When the user returns to the "Ribbon" customization tab ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains in the Part Tools custom panel list ✔ And the target indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks "Cancel" ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
